name: chrome-poster
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· GROUND: a vertical gradient from hot saturated colour at the top to a lighter warm tone at the bottom, covered in heavy PAPER GRAIN and print noise as if offset-printed on uncoated stock.
· PHOTOGRAPHY: a high-contrast photographic element cut out and composited onto the gradient, warm-toned, hard rim light, glossy skin and glossy garment.

· CHROME OBJECT: one large LIQUID CHROME form sits over the composition — mirror-polished, blue-white specular highlights, dark reflection bands, bevelled edges, hard cast reflections. It reads as poured molten metal, not as flat silver.
· LAYERING: the chrome form crosses in front of the photographic element, and part of the photograph crosses in front of the chrome — they interlock.
· PRINT FURNITURE: small registration ticks and hairline rules in the corners.
· PALETTE: hot orange and yellow ground, silver-blue chrome, warm skin. Nothing else.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
